title: cotoneaster rotundifolius var. lanatus
intro: Cotoneaster rotundifolius var. lanatus, commonly known as Woolly Cotoneaster, is a deciduous shrub native to the Himalayas and China. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster rotundifolius var. lanatus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
